📖 The Blobdex

Every blob has three evolutions. Green cards are blobs you own!

🌄 Grassy Plains

Grassy Plains — three sunny hills where the very first blobs live.

Earth Blob

A round brown blob.

A single sturdy brick.

The mighty brick pyramid.

Fire Blob

A round red ember.

A crackling flame.

An erupting volcano.

Water Blob

A little droplet blob.

A big sloshy blob.

A curling wave with foam.

Wind Blob

A round blob of breeze.

A little funnel, first cloud.

A tornado full of clouds.

🌲 Dark Forest

Dark Forest — a really foresty forest at night, with a crescent moon and firefly lights.

Dark Blob

A round shadow blob.

A dark star.

A crescent moon with craters.

Fairy Blob

A round magenta blob with a twinkle.

A magic star wand, ready to sparkle.

The great winged wand, four wings of magic.

Moss Blob

A jiggly blob of soft moss.

A mossy mound with hanging moss.

An old boulder wearing moss curtains.

Tree Blob

A little acorn blob with a cap.

A sapling, freshly sprouted!

A mighty tree with acorns growing in it.

☀️ Sunny Skies

Sunny Skies — puffy white clouds drifting past a bright sun.

Cloud Blob

A perfectly puffy little cloud ball.

One big puffy cloud.

Three big puffy clouds, all together.

Firework Blob

A little matchstick, not lit yet.

A striped rocket, fuse lit…

A teal-and-orange bursting sparkler.

Light Blob

A sunny round glow.

A bright beam on the move.

A fluffy cloud shining three big sunbeams.

Rain Blob

A drippy rain-blue blob with its own puddle.

Wears a raincloud hat — it rains on itself!

The Giant Raindrop — rain pours all around it.

⛏️ Deep Underground

Deep Underground — dirt as far as you can dig, full of gems of all colors.

Coal Blob

A little coal pebble.

A big sparkly lump of coal.

A burning furnace.

Copper Blob

Copper with oxidized green-blue patches.

A washer with a few strands of wire hair.

A copper pipe with lots of wire hair.

Gem Blob

A round blue blob.

A fancy little diamond, learning to sparkle.

A precious crystal — everyone wants it.

Gold Blob

A round golden blob.

A shiny gold bar.

The Gold King — heavy on his gold bars.

🏙️ Bustling Buildings

Bustling Buildings — a busy city full of colorful buildings.

Cloth Blob

The Pattern Blob, covered in patterns.

A red dish cloth.

Red curtains on a rod.

Heart Blobs

A round pink blob.

One pink heart, growing up.

A touching trio: happy, mad, and sad.

Brick Blob

A brick-red blob with mortar seams.

It stacked itself into a sturdy brick wall.

The Brick Tower — a castle turret with a flag.

Glass Blob

A frosted glass blob — almost see-through.

A tall glass of fizzy blue drink.

The Glass Skyscraper — all glowing windows.

🪐 Solar Space

Solar Space — the planet blobs' world, way out in space.

Mars Blob

A rusty-red blob with crater dents.

A real planet now — ice cap and big craters.

Mighty Mars — his two moons race around him!

Venus Blob

A creamy golden blob with soft cloud swirls.

Big golden swirl bands of cloud.

Glowing Venus — brightest thing in the sky.

Jupiter Blob

A stripy tan blob — two little bands.

More bands — and a little Red Spot mouth!

King Jupiter — the Great Red Spot is his mouth.

Saturn Blob

A golden blob with a hula-hoop ring.

A proper double ring now, tilted all fancy.

Lord of the Rings — rings all the way around.

🔥 The Hard Worlds

Every world has a HARD twin — and the Cyborg King’s minions are waiting!

🔥 Grassy Plains HARD

Grassy Plains after the Cyborg King came — the grass is dead, the ground is cracked, and it’s really, really hot.

Hard worlds get their own blobs — these four take over.

River Blob

A splashy blue blob with rippling waves.

A winding river flows across its face.

The River — a waterfall pours down its front.

Cactus Blob

A prickly green blob with one tiny bud.

Two stubby arms and a pink desert flower!

The Giant Saguaro — king of the desert.

Heat Blob

A sun-baked blob with one little sweat drop.

So hot it’s melting — droopy and drippy.

The Heatwave — melted into a glowing puddle.

Tumbleweed Blob

A loose tangle of twigs — see right through it!

Rolling! A thicker tangle, still mostly air.

The Great Tumbleweed — kicking up a dust storm.

⚙️ The Cyborg Minions

The Cyborg King’s silent robot soldiers — you battle them in Grassy Plains HARD!

River Minion

Half river-machine — the plain scout minion.

Flooded from below, with a periscope.

Water to the neck — periscope and radar dish.

Heat Minion

Half heat-machine, still mostly gray.

A wiggly melt-line and glowing vents.

Almost all machine — a glowing reactor core.

Cactus Minion

Half cactus-machine with its green plate.

Green armor with robot cactus spikes.

Full armor, spikes, a robot flower on top.

Tumbleweed Minion

Half tumbleweed-machine in dusty tan.

Twigs wrapped around a rolling wheel core.

A gear core with tank treads, puffing exhaust.

🌋 Dark Forest HARD

Dark Forest after the Cyborg King came — an earthquake ripped the forest wide open!

Root Blob

A root-brown blob with three little root tails.

Gnarly root arms and legs, twisting everywhere.

The Great Root — a sprout grows on his head.

Mud Blob

Pale forest gloop — drippy, with mud spots.

Gloopier! Popping bubbles, dripping mud.

The Mud Mountain — oozing into its own puddle.

Cave Blob

A little cave opened right in its belly.

Stalactite teeth — and two eyes peeking out.

The Cavern — a mountain cave full of bats.

Firefly Blob

A green glow-bug with a shining tail light.

Grew wings — and leaves little light trails!

The Lantern — a giant glow shines from behind.

⚙️ The Forest Minions

The Cyborg King’s robots followed the earthquake in — you battle them in Dark Forest HARD!

Root Minion

Half root-machine in woody brown.

A root-drill with a drill nose and cables.

Two drills now, with dirt flying off.

Mud Minion

Half mud-machine with muddy patches.

Mud splats everywhere and a pipe on top.

A mud mixer — a spinning drum in its belly.

Cave Minion

Half cave-machine, dark as stone.

A belly hatch — and it grew a headlamp.

A hatch full of bat-drones, two searchlights.

Firefly Minion

Half glow-machine in bug green.

A glow bulb hums behind it, wings of wire.

A Lantern-Bot — lights everywhere.

🌪️ Sunny Skies HARD

Sunny Skies after the Cyborg King came — tornadoes and storms tore the sky apart!

Tornado Blob

A storm-gray blob with a little wind curl.

A funnel tail — it can barely hold still!

The Twister — a full funnel, bits flying off.

Lightning Blob

Electric yellow, with one bolt mark.

Crackling! Spiky bolt hair and a big zigzag.

The Bolt — its whole body is a lightning bolt.

Thunder Blob

Storm-gray, with rumble lines on its belly.

Boom! Its edges burst into shock spikes.

The Boom — a storm-star with shock rings.

Hail Blob

Icy blue, with little hailstones stuck on.

Freezing harder — chunky lumps of ice.

The Hailstone — a giant crystal, frozen heart.

⚙️ The Sky Minions

The Cyborg King’s robots rode the storm in — you battle them in Sunny Skies HARD!

Tornado Minion

Half storm-machine in windy gray.

A spinning fan built right into its belly.

A giant turbine fan with swirl wings.

Lightning Minion

Half zap-machine in electric yellow.

A zapper coil on its head, sparking away.

Two zapper coils, a bolt charged inside.

Thunder Minion

Half boom-machine in storm gray.

A giant speaker in its belly — turn it down!

Double speakers shaking the air.

Hail Minion

Half ice-machine in frosty blue.

An ice-cube hatch opened in its belly.

A freezer window with an ice-pour spout.

🌋 Deep Underground HARD

Deep Underground after the Cyborg King came — the volcanoes woke up and lava is everywhere!

Ash Blob

Soft warm ash with tiny glowing embers.

Crumbly! Flakes drift off, embers glow.

The Ash Cloud — a plume full of embers.

Obsidian Blob

Glossy black glass with a purple shine.

Its edges are turning to sharp glass facets.

The Obsidian Shard — a jagged glass star.

Magma Blob

A glowing molten blob with bright hot swirls.

Black crust plates — glowing between cracks.

The Magma Flow — crust islands float on top.

Geyser Blob

A teal blob with steam puffs on its head.

Pressure building! A spout bursts up.

The Geyser — a steam column blasting up.

⚙️ The Lava Minions

The Cyborg King’s robots dug down after the lava — you battle them in Deep Underground HARD!

Ash Minion

Half ash-machine in ember gray.

A chimney on top, puffing little smoke wisps.

Two chimneys, a belly full of embers.

Obsidian Minion

Half glass-machine in shiny black.

A sharp obsidian blade-arm for slicing.

Two blade-arms, flashing purple.

Magma Minion

Half melt-machine in lava red.

A furnace hatch in its belly, glowing hot.

A big furnace with two heat pipes.

Geyser Minion

Half spring-machine in mineral teal.

A sprayer nozzle on its head, puffing steam.

A geyser cannon blasting a steam jet.

…and they all live in your Blobdex!

❓ The Secret World

🧪 THE TRUTH: an evil SCIENTIST BLOB has a mad-ray — HIS ray is what made all the blobs go bad! The bosses you beat were his victims. Now they are MADDER THAN EVER. Free all SIX… then face HIM.

📜 How to Play

🎯 The adventure: every world has 50 levels and a mighty BOSS at the end. Beat the boss, unlock the next world — all the way to the FINAL bosses! 🌍👑

🚩 Starting out: tap 🌍 Worlds, open your world, and tap the next level. Your first time? Tap level 1 and pick your first blob — the picking screen shows who each blob beats. There is no wrong pick! You will end up adding every blob.

⚔️ Battles take turns: on your turn, tap YOUR blob, then tap the enemy you want to attack. Then the enemy team strikes back. Last team standing wins!

🔄 Who beats who: a strong hit makes the enemy go POOF 💨 — a weak hit does nothing! Same family? More stars → beats fewer stars. Stuck? Tap the 🧠 Coach button in battle, or check the arrow charts in the 📖 Blobdex.

🟢 Coins: you get the most coins the first time you beat a level — and you can keep earning by replaying old levels! Each world pays its own kind of coins.

🏪 Buy teammates: soon the enemies come in TEAMS, so you need teammates too! New blobs are for sale at the Shop and join your team right away.

⭐ Evolving: beat level 15 and your blobs grow to two-star ⭐⭐. Beat level 40 → THREE-star ⭐⭐⭐! (In a hurry? The Shop sells evolutions too.) Big blobs are tough — hits shrink them before they poof.

👑 The boss: level 50! The boss has four colored sections — each one falls ONLY to its matching blob, and takes three hits. Bring all four blobs or you cannot win!

😎 Accessories: buy them at the Shop, then tap the ➕ Add accessories! buttons in the Blobdex to put them on your blobs. They wear them into battle!

⚔️ 2-Player: tap ⚔️ 2-Player to battle a friend on one screen. You can only use blobs you’ve EARNED — more stars means a better chance to hit! The 🧠 Coach shows the chances.

👥 Players: every name on the home page is a whole separate game — own coins, own blobs, own levels! Tap a name to switch players, or type a new name to add someone. (Each device keeps its own players.)

📱 Moving devices: PLAY → your name → “💾 Move my game” shows a QR square. Point the new device’s camera at it — done!
